title: The planarian dorsal–ventral boundary regulates anterior–posterior axis growth and patterning
content:
by Chloe L. Maybrun, Isaac M. Oderberg, Michael A. Gaviño, Thomas F. Cooke, Kyungyong Choi, Jongyoon Han, Peter W. Reddien

Regeneration in planarians requires alignment of new tissue axes with existing body axes, coordinated by the dorsal-ventral boundary (DVB). This study shows that the DVB is also essential for anterior-posterior axis patterning, acting independently of the anterior pole and enabling ectopic head formation through Wnt inhibition and spatial gene regulation.
author: Chloe L. Maybrun
